verses.he: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל־תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְו‍ֹתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: My son, forget not my teaching; But let thy heart keep my commandments;

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: For length of days, and years of life, And peace, will they add to thee.

verses.he: חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל־יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee; Bind them about thy neck, write them upon the table of thy heart;

verses.he: וּמְצָא־חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל־ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם׃
verses.en: So shalt thou find grace and good favour In the sight of God and man.

verses.he: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל־בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃
verses.en: Trust in the LORD with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding.

verses.he: בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: In all thy ways acknowledge Him, And He will direct thy paths.

verses.he: אַל־תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.en: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear the LORD, and depart from evil;

verses.he: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: It shall be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.

verses.he: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת־יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל־תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Honour the LORD with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase; .

verses.he: וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃
verses.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy vats shall overflow with new wine.

verses.he: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל־תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל־תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD, Neither spurn thou His correction;

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת־בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.en: For whom the LORD loveth He correcteth, Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that obtaineth understanding.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.en: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, And the gain thereof than fine gold.

verses.he: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מפניים [מִפְּנִינִ֑ים] וְכָל־חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־בָֽהּ׃
verses.en: She is more precious than rubies; And all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

verses.he: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honour.

verses.he: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל־נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.

verses.he: עֵץ־חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃
verses.en: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her, And happy is every one that holdest her fast.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד־אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens.

verses.he: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ־טָֽל׃
verses.en: By His knowledge the depths were broken up, And the skies drop down the dew.

verses.he: בְּ֭נִי אַל־יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.en: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes; Keep sound wisdom and discretion;

verses.he: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.

verses.he: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף׃
verses.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thou shalt not dash thy foot.

verses.he: אִם־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא־תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid; Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

verses.he: אַל־תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא׃
verses.en: Be not afraid of sudden terror, Neither of the destruction of the wicked, when it cometh;

verses.he: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד׃
verses.en: For the LORD will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being caught.

verses.he: אַל־תִּמְנַע־ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל ידיך [יָדְךָ֣] לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.en: Withhold not good from him to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.

verses.he: אַל־תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לרעיך [לְרֵֽעֲךָ֨׀] לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Say not unto thy neighbour: ‘Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give’; when thou hast it by thee.

verses.he: אַל־תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל־רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא־יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

verses.he: אַל־תרוב [תָּרִ֣יב] עִם־אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם־לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה׃
verses.en: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm. .

verses.he: אַל־תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל־תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל־דְּרָכָֽיו׃
verses.en: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת־יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD; But His counsel is with the upright.

verses.he: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.en: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked; But He blesseth the habitation of the righteous.

verses.he: אִם־לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא־יָלִ֑יץ ולעניים [וְ֝לַעֲנָוִ֗ים] יִתֶּן־חֵֽן׃
verses.en: If it concerneth the scorners, He scorneth them, But unto the humble He giveth grace.

verses.he: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The wise shall inherit honour; But as for the fools, they carry away shame.
